note: The base product's allow-list of the secret-pattern scan (lib/secrets.mjs; fe-country-split-plan §4.11 rule 4), which set-up runs over a country's fe/ inputs (scope inputs) and the build check over both applications' dist (scope dist). It is the base product's, like a CSP source: a country's false positive is a base product change, reviewed with its reason, never a file the country writes. An entry is { pattern: <pattern id>, files: <glob over the scanned paths, relative to the country's fe/>, scope: inputs | dist, reason, country?: <the one country it is for> }; one without a reason, with an unknown id, field or scope, or whose glob matches no file of its scan is an error. Measured over the example country's inputs, DK's and GL's in-tree inputs and the six builds of the base product: no finding, so no entry.
